contexts.text: To keep the things which are written therein () = to do the things which are therein.
Because thou hast kept the word of My endurance () = because they have fought against evils, and then have rejected falsities.
I will keep thee from the hour of temptation... () = that they will be protected and preserved in the day of the Last Judgment. AE 215.
Blessed is he who watcheth and keepeth his garments () = ... Heaven for those who look to Him, and remain in a life according to His precepts...
Blessed is he who keepeth the words of this prophecy () = that the Lord will... give eternal life to those who keep and do the truths... of the doctrine of this book... AR 946.
To observe and keep () = to perceive, will, and act according thereto. AE 15:2, Illustrated.
Thou hast kept the word of My endurance = those who have lived according to the Lord's precepts... To keep = to live.
To keep the Sabbath () = to be in conjunction with the Lord; and to keep His covenant = conjunction by a life according to the Lord's precepts.
Then Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell securely () = that then they shall be saved who are in love to Him.
A Preserver and a Prince () = the Lord, who is called a Preserver or Saviour from the good of love; and a Prince from the truths of faith.

To keep them from afar () = to save them although they are far from salvation. To keep from the land of captivity = to deliver from falsities, whereby they had been secluded from the truths and goods of Heaven and the Church.
If anyone keep My word, he shall never see death (). By to keep the Lord's words is signified to live according to the Lord's precepts.
And keepeth his garments () = those who live according to His Divine truths.
3. To keep My precepts, words, and commandments () = to do the goods of charity which are uses to the neighbour.
